# finna

Drawings from Helsingin kaupunginarkisto (Helsinki City Archives) and Arkkitehtuuri- ja designmuseo
(Architecture & Design Museum, Helsinki), published through Finna under CC BY 4.0
(https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Credit each file as given in the table below.

Changes: files renamed; most scans downscaled to at most 3,000 px and saved as JPEG. Originals are linked
from each record page.
